part.text:
Implemented Handlebars templating support:

- Added `handlebars` dependency.
- Supports `templates/*.hbs`, `templates/layouts/*.hbs`, and `templates/partials/*.hbs`.
- Frontmatter supports `template` and `layout`; defaults use `default.hbs`.
- Layouts receive raw `{{{body}}}` content.
- Partials are registered per build.
- Added `--templates <dir>` CLI option.
- Preserved built-in rendering when no templates directory exists.
- Added template/layout/partial/default-template tests.
